content.title: Jesus and the Word
content.author: Rudolf Bultmann (German original Jesus, Berlin, 1926; English translation New York: Scribner, 1934)
content.note: Bultmann's short book on Jesus' teaching, holding that almost nothing can be known of Jesus' life and personality and that faith does not need it. His form criticism of the Gospels (1921) set the method. In copyright: described in our own words and cited by chapter or whole work, never quoted; no page numbers are given because no copy is held.
